discoveryPolicy: Candidate ledger was gathered from public Debian bookworm arm64 package metadata, the published Alpine ARM64 minirootfs SHA-256 file, and the public Termux aarch64 Contents/package index. CI re-resolves no moving version: it downloads only these immutable URLs, checks the locked archive SHA-256, extracts the declared path, and emits the authoritative fingerprint.
